new_agent_start.rule: Read AGENT_START_HERE.md first. Work only within your assigned, non-overlapping lane. Use the latest combined report pointer for the parallel run it identifies. Keep executing agent-owned work until complete or a genuine human-only gate remains; do not stop at an executable next-step description. For shared Surveyor changes, submit a complete build request under build-requests/<lane>/<request-id>/ and publish the request bundle; the primary integration assistant compiles ready requests into one tested release. Do not publish a competing full Surveyor build.
resume_order: the assigned lane manifest and only relevant files/evidence
new_agent_start.branch_rule: For a new independent task, create a fresh branch from current main named agent/<short-lane-id>. Use agent/metadata only if it is still free when you begin.
new_agent_start.output_rule: Keep unfinished experiments on your lane branch. Publish completed, tested, documented lane research and build-request bundles to main with tests, evidence, lane status/manifest, base commit, verified file hashes, and rollback notes. Publish lane status/manifest updates to the lane branch for Agent Console and keep the main copy synchronized. Update WORKSPACE_STATE.json and affected AI_HANDOFF.md/research records when lane facts or shared pointers change, without overwriting unrelated lane findings. Shared Surveyor application/updater releases are compiled and published by the primary integration assistant from ready build requests.
new_agent_start.autonomy_rule: Continue until the objective is complete or only a genuine human-only gate remains. At each apparent stopping point, do the next useful action available through repository history, code, evidence, tests, or tools; diagnose failures and try a reasonable fix/fallback. After completing the assigned objective, continue with the next useful non-duplicative task in the lane. A dependency blocks only dependent work. Ask the user only for live PC/NMS action, inaccessible local evidence, unavailable credentials/authorization, or information only they can provide; finish independent work first and provide one exact numbered recipe.

artifact_policy.github_role: GitHub main is the shared continuity source for completed lane updates, manifests, status, handoffs, build requests, evidence, and integration history. Keep lane-branch status current for Agent Console as well.

cross_mode_rule: Normal ChatGPT and Work/Codex must treat committed GitHub state as authoritative and may switch roles without relying on hidden conversation context.
